newsitem.title: USA: Bull market is largely a large stock affair - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Bull market is largely a large stock affair - NYT.

text.p: The Dow Jones Industrial Average increased 15.6 percent to 6,521.70 from the end of May through the end of November, while the Russell 2000, the premier index of small-stock performance, declined 2.1 percent, the New York Times reported Tuesday.
While larger stocks are driving the raging bull market, smaller companies are seeing their shares go nowhere, the article said.
The relative strength of large capitalization stocks is seen by some, according to the article, as a sign that portfolio managers are seeking defensive positions, fearing a market setback.
